scholarlyStandard: Sunni classical works, distributed verbatim with edition, translator and rights metadata. No text is paraphrased or attributed to a scholar who did not write it.

editions.title: Tafsir al-Jalalayn (English translation)
editions.author: Jalal al-Din al-Mahalli (d. 864 AH) and Jalal al-Din al-Suyuti (d. 911 AH)
editions.methodology: Concise classical grammatical, linguistic and contextual commentary
editions.publisher: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute for Islamic Thought (altafsir.com)

coverage.note: Every verse of the Quran has an English entry in the bundled edition.

editions.rightsNote: English translation © Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute for Islamic Thought. Bundled with attribution for non-commercial educational use; commercial redistribution requires the Institute's permission. Flagged for owner review.
editions.verificationNote: Downloaded verbatim on 2026-10-29 and checked for coverage, empty entries, raw HTML and replacement characters. Not independently collated against a printed edition.

editions.title: Tafsir al-Jalalayn (Arabic original)
editions.author: Jalal al-Din al-Mahalli (d. 864 AH) and Jalal al-Din al-Suyuti (d. 911 AH)
editions.methodology: Concise classical grammatical, linguistic and contextual commentary
editions.publisher: Classical text; digitisation distributed in the Tafsir API dataset

coverage.note: The digitised Arabic edition omits 226 verses. Missing entries are shown as missing; they are not filled in from another edition.

editions.rightsNote: The Arabic original is a classical work whose authors died in 864 AH and 911 AH; the text itself is in the public domain. The digitisation is used as distributed by the Tafsir API dataset.
editions.verificationNote: Downloaded verbatim on 2026-10-29 and checked for coverage, empty entries, raw HTML and replacement characters. Coverage gaps are recorded per surah in public/data/tafsir/manifest.json.

editions.title: Asbab al-Nuzul — occasions of revelation (Arabic reports)
editions.author: Reports compiled in Ṣaḥīḥ Asbāb al-Nuzūl by Ibrāhīm Muḥammad al-ʿAlī
editions.methodology: Reported occasions of revelation, quoted in Arabic without translation

coverage.note: Only verses for which the compilation records an occasion have an entry. Absence of an entry is not a claim that no occasion exists. Reports are Arabic only.

editions.rightsNote: Dataset released under the MIT licence. The reports themselves are classical hadith and reports quoted in the named compilation; no English translation is bundled.
editions.verificationNote: Downloaded verbatim on 2026-10-29. One source anomaly is recorded: the dataset lists Surah 96 ayahs 6–20 although the surah has 19 verses; ayahs 6–19 were kept and ayah 20 discarded.

editions.title: NoorDeen editorial summary
editions.author: NoorDeen editorial team
editions.methodology: Modern English paraphrase written for this site

coverage.note: Only six key verses have an editorial summary. These are clearly labelled as NoorDeen editorial text and are never attributed to Ibn Kathir, al-Jalalayn or any other scholar.

editions.rightsNote: Written for NoorDeen. It is a paraphrase and must not be quoted as a translation of any classical commentary.
editions.verificationNote: Reviewed for attribution wording only; not a substitute for a published tafsir.

notBundled.title: Tafsir Ibn Kathir
notBundled.reason: No licensed verbatim text is bundled. The six existing English summaries are NoorDeen editorial paraphrases, not Ibn Kathir's words, and are registered under the editorial edition only.

notBundled.title: Al-Tafsir al-Muyassar
notBundled.reason: Not bundled. No verified text or redistribution permission has been obtained.
